LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Mag. m.]
Sensation of great fatigue in legs, even while sitting.
Heaviness in legs.
Twitching, tearing in hips.
Restlessness and tense feeling in thighs, must move legs for relief.
Pressing pain in knees.
Cramps in calves at night.
Burning in soles, evenings.
Foot sweat.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Mag. m.]
Much weakness in limbs. θ Uterus displaced.
Paralytic drawing and tearing in limbs.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Mag. m.]
Rest : cough <.
Lying : dulness of head < ; griping, raging in temples ; cough <.
Must lie down : pain in forehead.
Must lie crooked : colic.
Cannot lie on right side : liver sensitive.
Must lie on left side : palpitation.
Cannot lie on left side : something (liver) seems to drag to that side.
On side upon which one rests : sensation as of boiling water.
Can lie only on back or affected side : pain in liver.
Sitting : palpitation ; pains in thighs ; cough < ; pulse accelerated, with ebullitions ; great fatigue in legs.
Motion : headache < ; pain in forehead > ; palpitation > ; rheumatic pain in shoulder, arm and hand <.
Must move legs : restlessness >.
Exercise in open air : > dulness of head ; leucorrhœa.
Getting up and walking : palpitation >.
Walking : regurgitation ; pressing pain in liver ; pains in back.
Ascending steps : cough <.
Tossing about in bed and on floor for two hours : pain in stomach.
   

NERVES. [36] [Mag. m.]
General sensation of soreness, with great sensitiveness to noise.
Hysterical and spasmodic complaints ; uterine troubles.
Many spasms day and night, sleeplessness ; fainting fits at table, nausea and trembling, > by eructations. θ Hysteria.
Weakness and chill, < during hysterical paroxysm.
Great weakness from a sea bath.
Weakness of body as if coming from stomach.
Fainting fits at dinner, nausea and trembling, > by eructations.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Mag. m.]
Sleepiness during day, with yawning and sluggishness.
Goes to sleep late ; sleeplessness on account of nightly heat, with thirst.
Restlessness of body as soon as she closes eyes ; evening in bed.
Shocks through body at night, while waking.
Sleep unrefreshing ; tired in morning.
Anxious, frightful dreams, with talking and crying out during sleep.
   

TIME. [38] [Mag. m.]
Morning : dulness in head < ; on rising vertigo ; burning in nose ; tongue coated white ; nausea ; diarrhœa ; frequent erections ; leucorrhœa < ; roughness and dryness of throat ; arms "go to sleep ;" is tired.
At 1 A. M. : pain in stomach ; colic.
At 3 A. M. : violent thirst.
Day : frequent desire to urinate ; expectoration watery but tough ; many spasms ; sleepiness.
At dinner sudden heaviness of chest, with oppression of breathing ; fainting fits.
From 4 to 8 P. M. : chill <.
After supper : tinea ciliaris <.
Evening : after lying down, pain in temples ; colic in evening ; diarrhœa ; dry cough ; cough < till midnight ; burning in soles ; in bed, restlessness of body ; heat.
Evening till 12 P. M. : heat.
Night : obstruction of nose ; eruption on face and forehead ; drawing pain in abdomen ; diarrhœa ; frequent desire to urinate ; metrorrhagia < in bed ; dry cough ; spasmodic cough ; cramps in calves ; many spasms ; shocks through body.
From 12 P. M. till morning : sweat.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Mag. m.]
Sensitive to cold air.
Great disposition to take cold.
Warm wrapping up of head : > dulness of head ; > pain in forehead.
Warm room : tinea ciliaris < ; eruption on face and forehead <.
Near stove : chill.
In room : cough <.
After getting into bed : great chilliness ; chill >.
Open air : anxious feeling > ; dulness > ; vertigo > ; headache < ; pain in forehead > ; chill >.
Sea bathing : bloody expectoration ; great weakness.
Aversion to uncovering.
   

FEVER. [40] [Mag. m.]
Chill : even near stove ; < from 4 to 8 P. M. ; > in open air or in bed ; chill followed by heat, evening, until 12 P. M.
Evening heat, thirst ; averse to uncovering.
Sweat : on head or feet ; with thirst, from 12 P. M. till morning.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Mag. m.]
One hour before food : pain in epigastric region.
For one hour after breakfast : feels quite well, then cardialgia.
Several times during day : cardialgia.
Daily : attacks of pain in head.
Every evening : gastralgia.
Nightly : agglutination of lids ; heat, with thirst.
Every three or four days : difficult stools.
Once in four days : stool.
Once a week : bowels moved.
Every eight days : bowels move.
Fourteen days late : menses.
Two weeks after menstruation : leucorrhœa for three or four days.
Since parturition five weeks ago : diarrhœa.
Every six weeks : pain in forehead and around eyes.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Mag. m.]
Right : tearing in side of head ; tenderness of ovary ; dragging pain from ovary ; weight in hypochondrium ; could not rest on side ; pain in scapula ; hypochondrium tender to touch ; painful hardness of abdomen.
Left : must lie on side ; cannot lie on side.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Mag. m.]
Boring and spasmodic, contractive pains.
General sensation of soreness, with great sensitiveness to noises.
Sensation as if some one was reading after her and she must read faster and faster ; as if boiling water was on side of head ; as if one would fall down ; as if head would burst ; as if hair was raised by pulling ; as if he would become dizzy and lose consciousness ; as if something was lying before ear ; upper incisors as if too long ; tongue as if burnt ; inner mouth as if scalded ; rising as of a ball from stomach to throat ; as if stomach was cut to pieces ; as of something dragging over to hypochondriac region ; abdomen as if bruised ; stools as if burnt ; as if from excoriation ; pain as if bruised in small of back and hips ; weakness as if coming from stomach.
Pain : in forehead and around eyes ; in stomach ; in liver ; in epigastric region ; in uterus ; in hypogastric region ; in small of back and both hips.
Insupportable pain : in teeth.
Violent pains : in back and thighs.
Severe cardialgia.
Severe cramp pains : in bones of face.
Tearing : in temple ; in nodosities on occiput ; in abdomen ; in small of back ; in shoulders, arms, wrists and hands ; in hips.
Sharp sticking and tearing : in right side of head to eye.
Tearing stitches : in loins.
Paralytic drawing and tearing : in limbs.
Griping, raging : in temples.
Contractive, spasmodic pain : in small of back.
Beating : in forehead.
Stitches : in temple ; in heart ; in small of back.
Eroding pain : in stomach.
Sore pain : in nose.
Cutting, pinching : in abdomen.
Gnawing : at pit of stomach.
Cramps : in abdomen ; in calves.
Colicky pains : in abdomen.
Violent burning : of rhagades on tongue ; of nose.
Burning pain : in back.
Drawing pain : in abdomen.
Dragging down pain : from right ovary to thigh.
Bearing down : in ovarian region.
Dull, aching, tensive pain : in hypochondriac region, going through to right scapula.
Stitching pains : in rectum.
Rheumatic pain : in shoulder joints to arm and hands.
Pressing pain : in stomach ; in liver ; to back and stomach ; in knees.
Constrictive pain : in chest and scapulæ.
Throbbing : in pit of stomach.
Painful undulating and whizzing : in head.
Painful hardness : of right side of abdomen.
Painful swelling : of gums.
Tingling, stinging : in abdominal muscles.
Soreness : of abdomen ; in chest ; all over.
Burning : of eyes ; of nose ; of vesicles on lip ; in anus ; in urethra ; in penis ; in chest ; in small of back ; in soles.
Hot feeling : in head.
Rawness : of inner surface of alæ nasi.
Irritation : about anus.
Tenderness : of right ovary ; in hypogastric region.
Roughness : on inner side of upper lip ; of throat.
Tickling : in throat.
Tingling : in larynx.
Dryness : of nose distressing ; of mouth and tongue ; of tongue.
Sensitiveness : of teeth ; of stomach and liver ; of lower part of nose.
Compressive sensation : in head.
Tension and constriction : of chest.
Oppression : in pit of stomach ; in chest.
Great fatigue : in legs.
Much weakness : in limbs ; from a sea bath.
Weakness : in stomach.
Pulsation : in ears.
Distress : in hypogastric region.
Restlessness and tense feeling : in thighs.
Restlessness : of body.
Dull feeling : in head.
Numbness : in forehead ; of urethra.
Heaviness : in head ; in bowels ; on chest ; in legs.
Twitching : in hips.
Formication : over whole body.
Itching : of old herpes behind ears ; of vesicles on lip ; in nose ; at anus ; on genitals ; on scrotum.
Coldness : in stomach.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Mag. m.]
Swelling of glands ; engorged glands.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Mag. m.]
Touch : nodosities on occiput painful ; burning in nose < ; of food against teeth pain insupportable ; of upper lip with tongue, sensation of roughness ; pressing pain in liver ; right hypochondrium tender ; abdomen sensitive ; small of back and hips sensitive.
Cannot endure covering : colic.
Pressure : stomach and liver sensitive ; causes beating in forehead ; pain in eye > ; griping, raging in temples ; stomach painful ; on back > menstrual pains.
Strong pressure : pain in forehead.
Tying tight bandage around head : headache >.
   

SKIN. [46] [Mag. m.]
Blood-boils ; eruption of pustules or small red papillæ.
Formication over whole body.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Mag. m.]
Especially suitable for diseases of women ; spasmodic and hysterical complaints complicated with uterine diseases.
Women after suffering months or years from attacks of indigestion or biliousness ; enlargement and congestion of liver.
Children, especially during dentition ; puny, rachitic.
Boy, æt. 1 ; much straining at urination.
Child, æt. 2, for several months diarrhœa and cough ; after diarrhœa stopped, constipation and cough.
Girl, æt. 4, suffering two years ; affection of liver.
Young woman, æt. 17 ; cardialgia.
Girl, æt. 18, after disappearance of an eruption which came every winter upon upper and lower lips ; affection of nose.
Woman, æt. 19, small, blonde, sensitive, suffering four years ; affection of liver.
Girl, æt. 20, suffering several years ; affection of stomach.
Young woman, æt. 20, anemic ; chronic diarrhœa.
Woman, æt. 20, mother of one child ; constipation.
Young woman, æt. 23, anemic, a week previously vomited about a cupful of blood and suffered thereafter from pains in stomach and anorexia, removed by Ipec. and Nux vom. ; diarrhœa.
Woman, æt. 24, tall, strong, dark hair, suffering five years ; affection of liver.
Young man, stout, healthy looking ; cardialgia.
Woman, æt. 26, pale, weak, confined two years ago ; constipation.
Woman, suffering one month ; affection of liver.
Woman, suffering two years ; affection of liver.
Woman, æt. 35, previously strong, now somewhat anemic, after parturition ; diarrhœa.
Woman, æt. 36, mother of two children, during childhood had ague ; periodical attacks of pain in stomach and enlargement of liver.
Man, æt. 40, Russian, strong, hardened by much travel, after inflammation of liver ten years ago ; induration of liver.
Man, æt. 48, sallow, choleric, attacks return every six weeks, suffering several years ; cephalalgia.
Woman, æt. 51, wife of gravedigger, five years ago suffered from leucorrhœa, cured by Sepia ; gastric disturbances.
Woman, æt. 52, suffering two months ; affection of liver.
Woman, æt. 58, had been subject to repeated attacks of biliousness and disturbance of functions of liver for several years, attended with dyspepsia and constipation ; enlargement and congestion of liver.
Woman, æt. 60, dark hair, strong, suffering one and a half years ; palpitation of heart.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Mag. m.]
Antidoted by : Arsen., Camphor., Chamom., Nux. vom.
It antidotes : Mercur. (metrorrhagia).
Compatible : Bellad., Lycop., Natr. mur., Pulsat., Sepia.
Compare : Baryta, Bryon., Calc., Graphit., Kali carb., Nitr. ac., Phosphor., Sulphur.
